text: Twenty lessons, one arc: why AI matters now, Copilot inside Fabric, anomaly detection and documentation, the prompting patterns underneath it all, then RAG from concept to a real pipeline.

Lessons 43-46 grounded AI in Copilot inside Fabric. 47-48 moved into data quality and documentation. 49 stepped back to the prompting patterns underneath everything. 50-52 built RAG from concept to an actual pipeline.

53-55 moved from generating to verifying — tests, an RCA draft, a schema mapping. 56 drew the hard line on guardrails. 57-58 covered what verification costs and how to run it. 59 pulled it all into one worked example.
60 anchored the whole chapter back into the production practices Course 3 already taught. 61 closed with the honest limits — no invented capabilities, no hype.
Chapter 3 is complete. Next up: Chapter 4, Added Projects — Capstones, three mini-capstone projects that put this whole track into practice.
